name: SDN Discovery Response Shaper
description: Single-purpose flow node pair shaping the network-discovery responses (gateway loop G.2). Pure compute — no capabilities. Both methods take the discovery routing-decision JSON plus the raw p2p.*_snapshot hostcall response envelope and emit decision/body/etag for foundation/http-respond. Method 'peers' (peers_list/peer_get): fb body = one size-prefixed $EPM frame per selected peer (stored profile spliced verbatim via epm_index, else a synthesized minimal unsigned EPM: DN=peer id, MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS=[/p2p/<peerId>, ...addrs], ENTITY_TYPE=Node); json body = bare array of {peer_id,self,connected,agent_version,addrs,standards,epm|null}; an unknown peer_get id rewrites the decision to route=not_found (404). Method 'standards': fb body = newest signed $PNM per (peer, standard) spliced verbatim in entry order; json body = bare array of {peer_id,standard,schema,file_id,file_name,cid,publish_timestamp}. The etag is the weak word-folded FNV-1a-64 over the fb-encoded record stream for BOTH encodings (identical logical stream => identical tag), byte-compatible with foundation/decision-gate. Method 'shape_pnm' (route pnm_history, loop G.3): fb body = the publisher's stored signed $PNM frames spliced VERBATIM (signatures intact) newest first; json body = bare array of {publisher_peer_id,gossip_peer_id,standard,schema,file_id,file_name,cid,publish_timestamp,signature_type,signature,signature_verified,attribution,publisher_key|null,publisher_key_source|null}; zero entries rewrite the decision to not_found (404). Attribution honesty: the store records the gossip-delivering peer; the host attributes to the PUBLISHER by Ed25519 signature verification and the entry fields expose exactly which claim each record makes. G.4 adds method 'shape_latest' for the provider-scoped latest-dataset surface (see the method description).

methods.description: Shapes the GET /api/v1/peers/{peerId}/{standard}/latest response (gateway loop G.4) from the decision + p2p.latest_dataset envelope. known=false -> decision rewritten to route=not_found (honest 404). known without "serving" (not pinned / not yet materialized) -> route=error status=503 with the newest signed-PNM pointer object in the decision (http-respond forwards it into the error body) — pinning is OPT-IN and there is NO silent proxy fetch. serving present: etag = W/"fnv1a64-<serving.etag_fnv1a64>" (host-hashed with the shared word-folded algorithm, one tag for both encodings); default fb path pushes the batch stream on "body" — the inline envelope segment verbatim or the host's {"$sdnbodyref":...} body-reference descriptor; format=json pushes the raw $OMM stream on "stream" for the downstream foundation/omm-json encoder (non-OMM standards answer route=error status=406 — no lossy json guess).
